Name: Zedekiah, King of Judah
Summary: Zedekiah, born Mattaniah, was made king by Nebuchadnezzar, rebelled in his ninth year, and watched Jerusalem fall; his sons were slain before his eyes, he was blinded, and he died a prisoner in Babylon.
KeyStory: Zedekiah rebels, Jerusalem falls, and he is blinded and bound.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 24:17; 2 Kings 25:7; 2 Chronicles 36:10; 2 Chronicles 36:12; 2 Chronicles 36:13; Jeremiah 21:1; Jeremiah 32:4-5; Jeremiah 38:14-23; Jeremiah 39:5-7
RelatedPeople: King Nebuchadnezzar; Jehoiachin, King of Judah; Hamutal, Mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah; Jeremiah; Jehoiakim, King of Judah; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Rebellion against God's appointed discipline ends in the very darkness Zedekiah chose.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
